grasp verb

also grab, take hold of, grip, coloured holds

classical

prehendō, prehendere, prehendī, prehēnsum

verb, third conjugation

grasp, take hold of

Examples

  • Prehende rubram / caeruleam / viridem / flāvam.

    Grab the red / blue / green / yellow one, with feminine accusative ansam understood.composed

  • ansa alba; ansa nigra

    a white hold; a black holdcomposed
